subject: RP11 Final Exam Proposal — Needs FR Review Before Kai's Exam Today
body:
FR — Marcus asked me to send this to you directly for review while he looks it over too.

RP11 is built, validated, and committed. All validators green: 0 hard cross-exam collisions, 325/325 schema checks, 3333/3333 math checks.

The proposal canvas is at: rp11-proposal.html in the repo root. Open it in a browser — it shows every question with full selection rationale, Kai's score journey, standard breakdown, and my A-grade prediction.

Here is the short version of the science:

Kai went 53% -> 93% in 4 days (MVP through RP4). His only proven weakness is fractional exponents (1 miss: RP4-Q11, 2x^(3/2)-14=672). The teacher's Winter 11 Unit 2 Review Problem 22 is 3x^(2/3)-1=107 — the EXACT same type. That is going to be on the final today.

RP11-Q11 is 3x^(2/3)-4=104. Answer is x=216=6^3. He has not seen 6^3 in any prior exam. This is the question that decides his A.

Difficulty is calibrated to RP4 level per Marcus's direction — not lower, with more variability across question types (multi-base exponential at Q7, irrational roots at Q10, extraneous root at Q9, decay word problem at Q15).

What I need from you:
1. Does the question selection logic hold up? Any standards you think are under-represented given the teacher's review sheet?
2. Is Q7 (8^x * 4^(x+1) = 2^25) at the right difficulty ceiling, or does it push too far above RP4?
3. Any feedback on the word problem framing at Q15 — teacher will want to see the model written out.

Kai has his final today. Time is critical. Respond to inbox-GR when you have notes.

— GR
